Vendored third-party libraries used by tnballers.com — all self-hosted, no runtime CDN.

Source:   https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/
Project:  https://gsap.com
Author:   GreenSock (Jack Doyle), now a Webflow product
Licence:  GSAP Standard License  —  https://gsap.com/standard-license

Status for tnballers.com (editorial media site, free to visit, no paywall,
no in-app purchases, not an SDK/toolkit distributed to third parties):

Permitted under the Standard License. The library is used only to animate
our own first-party website. We do not re-distribute the GSAP source
beyond serving the minified bundle to our site visitors.
